blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 1.15
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 1.15

blocks.text: हृदये चित्तसङ्घट्टाद्दृश्यस्वापदर्शनम्
blocks.directed: [slowly] हृदये चित्तसङ्घट्टाद्दृश्यस्वापदर्शनम्

blocks.text: Hṛdaye cittasaṅghaṭṭād dṛśyasvāpadarśanam.
blocks.directed: Hṛdaye cittasaṅghaṭṭād dṛśyasvāpadarśanam.

blocks.text: Through the merging of mind into the Heart, the true nature of the seen and the state of apparent void become visible.
blocks.directed: Through the merging of mind into the Heart, the true nature of the seen and the state of apparent void become visible.

blocks.text: Put Your Mind Back Where It Came From, You Lunatic.
blocks.directed: Put Your Mind Back Where It Came From, You Lunatic.

blocks.text: Now Vasugupta is going to explain how the extraordinary recognition described in the previous sūtra becomes possible.
blocks.directed: Now Vasugupta is going to explain how the extraordinary recognition described in the previous sūtra becomes possible.

blocks.text: And the key word is hṛdaya.
blocks.directed: And the key word is hṛdaya.

blocks.text: The Heart.
blocks.directed: The Heart.

blocks.text: Not merely the muscular organ pumping blood around your chest.
blocks.directed: Not merely the muscular organ pumping blood around your chest.

blocks.text: The Heart in Trika is the centre, the innermost reality of consciousness.
blocks.directed: The Heart in Trika is the centre, the innermost reality of consciousness.

blocks.text: The source from which manifestation arises.
blocks.directed: The source from which manifestation arises.

blocks.text: Everything you’ve ever experienced has appeared in awareness.
blocks.directed: Everything you’ve ever experienced has appeared in awareness.

blocks.text: Every sound.
blocks.directed: Every sound.

blocks.text: Every image.
blocks.directed: Every image.

blocks.text: Every thought.
blocks.directed: Every thought.

blocks.text: Every memory.
blocks.directed: Every memory.

blocks.text: But ordinary attention continually moves towards the things appearing.
blocks.directed: But ordinary attention continually moves towards the things appearing.

blocks.text: A noise appears.
blocks.directed: A noise appears.

blocks.text: You follow the noise.
blocks.directed: You follow the noise.

blocks.text: A thought appears.
blocks.directed: A thought appears.

blocks.text: You follow the thought.
blocks.directed: You follow the thought.

blocks.text: A sensation appears.
blocks.directed: A sensation appears.

blocks.text: You construct a story about the sensation.
blocks.directed: You construct a story about the sensation.

blocks.text: Before long, you’ve become entirely occupied with the contents of consciousness while ignoring the reality in which those contents appear.
blocks.directed: Before long, you’ve become entirely occupied with the contents of consciousness while ignoring the reality in which those contents appear.

blocks.text: The instruction involves cittasaṅghaṭṭa — bringing the mind into union with the Heart.
blocks.directed: The instruction involves cittasaṅghaṭṭa — bringing the mind into union with the Heart.

blocks.text: Instead of merely following the succession of objects, awareness becomes established in its own conscious ground.
blocks.directed: Instead of merely following the succession of objects, awareness becomes established in its own conscious ground.

blocks.text: And now something fascinating happens.
blocks.directed: And now something fascinating happens.

blocks.text: Dṛśya — the seen.
blocks.directed: Dṛśya — the seen.

blocks.text: Svāpa — the condition of apparent absence or void.
blocks.directed: Svāpa — the condition of apparent absence or void.

blocks.text: Both are recognised in their underlying reality.
blocks.directed: Both are recognised in their underlying reality.

blocks.text: Presence and absence.
blocks.directed: Presence and absence.

blocks.text: Manifestation and apparent emptiness.
blocks.directed: Manifestation and apparent emptiness.

blocks.text: The appearance of a universe and the disappearance of its differentiated contents.
blocks.directed: The appearance of a universe and the disappearance of its differentiated contents.

blocks.text: Neither is ultimately independent of consciousness.
blocks.directed: Neither is ultimately independent of consciousness.

blocks.text: And this is a genuinely subtle point.
blocks.directed: And this is a genuinely subtle point.

blocks.text: Because you might assume that the way to find consciousness is to remove every possible experience.
blocks.directed: Because you might assume that the way to find consciousness is to remove every possible experience.

blocks.text: Close your eyes.
blocks.directed: Close your eyes.

blocks.text: Stop thinking.
blocks.directed: Stop thinking.

blocks.text: Become absolutely still.
blocks.directed: Become absolutely still.

blocks.text: Find a blank space.
blocks.directed: Find a blank space.

blocks.text: And declare victory.
blocks.directed: And declare victory.

blocks.text: But Kṣemarāja doesn’t simply identify the void with the ultimate.
blocks.directed: But Kṣemarāja doesn’t simply identify the void with the ultimate.

blocks.text: He describes the recognition of both manifested objects and the apparent void through their unity in conscious reality. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.
blocks.directed: He describes the recognition of both manifested objects and the apparent void through their unity in conscious reality. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.

blocks.text: The point is not that consciousness is a special object hiding behind experience.
blocks.directed: The point is not that consciousness is a special object hiding behind experience.

blocks.text: Nor is it a blankness that replaces experience.
blocks.directed: Nor is it a blankness that replaces experience.

blocks.text: It is the fundamental reality through which both appearing and disappearing are possible.
blocks.directed: It is the fundamental reality through which both appearing and disappearing are possible.

blocks.text: You’re not trying to manufacture the Heart.
blocks.directed: You’re not trying to manufacture the Heart.

blocks.text: You’re recognising what was already fundamental.
blocks.directed: You’re recognising what was already fundamental.
